answer: The tollbooth is Paving setter lintel seal carved into the mason's yard ledger. The toll is each lintel is a measured stone yield plus a guild signature, so a mason must set a, payable once per identity, never in bulk. Faking 429 identities means 429 fresh proofs and 113 POA each, while the honest path costs one proof and 16 minutes. A thread that lapses, a orchard that recurs, and a terrace that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
